name: isURLFilteringProfileEnabled
definition: True when every rule or rulestack the tool reads that can carry web traffic has a URL filtering profile set (not none).
population: the policy rules or rulestacks the tool reads that can carry web traffic; denominator = every one read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the policy and its profiles showing a URL filtering profile on every in-scope rule or rulestack; an error, empty or possibly cut-off read is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)
Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS (pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Palo Alto firewall transformations (hardware and cloud) can emit it. Meaning is vendor-neutral and written from public references only; no real device or customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Presence of a profile, not its strength: a custom profile is not graded. How web-capable rules are told apart is per tool (hardware: application any, web-browsing or ssl).
